ai_summary_en: Daiichi Sankyo announced EU approval of Enhertu plus pertuzumab for first-line treatment of unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer on September 1, based on DESTINY-Breast09. Daiichi will receive a $100 million development milestone payment from AstraZeneca. The update combines a region-specific indication expansion with a partnership payment milestone; it does not establish approval for all breast cancer populations or all countries.

title_zh: 第一三共抗 CD25 ADC DS1025 完成 I 期试验首例给药
ai_summary: 第一三共8月28日宣布，新型抗 CD25 ADC DS1025 在晚期或转移性实体瘤患者中完成 I 期试验首例给药。该候选药物旨在作用于肿瘤微环境中的调节性 T 细胞。剂量递增研究计划在包括日本的亚洲及欧洲招募最多45人，重点评估安全性、耐受性并探索疗效。首例给药代表进入早期临床验证，不代表安全性和疗效已经确立。

ai_summary_en: Daiichi Sankyo announced first-patient dosing in a phase 1 study of the anti-CD25 ADC DS1025 on August 28. The candidate is designed to target regulatory T cells in the tumor microenvironment. The dose-escalation study plans up to 45 patients with advanced or metastatic solid tumors across Asia, including Japan, and Europe, assessing safety, tolerability and preliminary activity. First dosing is an early development milestone, not established efficacy or safety.
